<!-- r1-5108-topology-successor -->
Required successor #5108 now owns the conditional compressed topology. This #5105 component retains its original v1 identical-page/CRC/ID reference and private ownership evidence; #5108 records the explicit representation change and requires independent logical/retirement/reservation/recovery equivalence plus canonical new-format bytes/counts. Atomic landing with #5103/#5095 remains allowed; all original parent capacities, foreground/noise/storage gates remain open.
<!-- /r1-5108-topology-successor -->

## Problem and selected architecture

The source-frozen L candidate removes manifest rescans and eager allocator index images, but public publication setup still allocates19.43/19.20 times the matched current-main control. Forty fresh wholeGC/concurrentACK calls retain all full oracles; only one of four noise groups passes, and concurrent512 ACKp95 is18.0% slower with admitted noise. Result: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5095#issuecomment-6041311772.

At e52d421132e05dc4d4dd3af24946adfd9380c474, cloneForAllocatorPrepare shares dirty tree aliases with rollback. mutateChunk always clones a14-nibble path plus leaf and256-entry chunk on every mutation invocation; retire/prune/auxiliary allocation/metadata reuse revisit those paths. A full public512 allocation diagnostic samples15.36MB cloneStateNode and12.13MB stateChunk.clone flat. Their27.49MB sum is an optimistic ceiling, not a savings forecast. First copies, rollback isolation and required visible/seal preparations remain.

Extend the existing transaction/mutation implementation with an explicitly private preparation boundary: isolate pre-existing dirty aliases from rollback, then copy each immutable path/chunk on first write and edit only proven transaction-owned unmaterialized nodes until materialization freezes them. PageID zero alone does not prove ownership. Preserve logical mutation and allocation order, identical page IDs/full bytes/CRC/reservations, summary and metadata counts. Consolidate the existing repeated cloning path rather than add another allocator, registry, global cache or pool.

## Deliverable, ownership and dependencies

Primary deliverable: PR implementation allowed to land atomically with #5103 and #5095. Acceptance owner: #5090 coordinator. Required predecessors: accepted #5091 decision, landed #5101 harness and exact #5103/#5095 detached-plan source snapshot e52d. This is a scoped allocator preparation slice; broad #5044/C3/C4/M7 and externally owned #5015/#5016/PR#5037 stay open with their existing owners. #5095 remains a required successor and unaccepted. This child does not replace its foreground/noise/storage/rollout gates or full H/E.

Production path: CheckpointOwnedLeafManifest -> finalizeCommitLockedWithOptions -> prepareVisibleCandidate -> PrepareCOWCandidateRetiringWithLimitsV1 -> staged transaction mutation/materialization. Durable sealing also consumes that allocator method with distinct auxiliary/slot retirements and a fresh pin horizon. Keep both generations and phase boundaries; source evidence does not authorize fusing them.

Owned edit seams: TreeDB/freelist/generation_v1_txn.go, generation_v1_tree.go, generation_v1_metadata_reuse.go and allocator_cow.go plus focused tests. Root/publication/closure discovery changes are separately owned. Preparation token/table bookkeeping and private detachment must have a source-derived finite backing/lifetime bound inside existing admission; include allocation-class sizes and old/new overlap. No cap or default increase. Preserve opaque reuse capabilities, rollback restoration, append burns, resource-sync/index-sync/meta-sync/prefix consumption, both durable slots, held roots and retirement horizons.

## Test-first and acceptance evidence

- [ ] First reproduce repeated path/chunk copies for multiple admitted mutations in one chunk using actual work counters or a focused red allocation/ownership invariant. Add a decisive reference oracle against existing persistent mutation semantics, not a test that merely mirrors the new helper.
- [ ] Candidate IDs, exact4096-byte pages/CRC, allocation choices, normalized reservations, summaries, metadata count and prune outcomes match the persistent reference for repeated/adjacent/sparse chunks, reused metadata, dirty rollback aliases and multiple preparations.
- [ ] Abort/failure before or inside materialization restores rollback bytes/state/capacity; retained base/candidate views survive fork/abort/release/later mutation and generic retaining/mutating sinks. No owner token survives as mutable candidate authority. Current prefix/dual-slot/held-root/recovery/fault tests and affected races pass.
- [ ] Counters show copies scale with distinct first-written paths/chunks within the private preparation boundary, while actual visits/mutation work remain charged. Constructor/isolation/capacity growth and transient overlap are admitted before allocation; no uncharged map or identity growth.
- [ ] Independent source review and immutable compiled-input/binary freeze precede the discriminating public forced-history128/512 diagnostic. Report copy bytes, distinct/visited paths, metadata/COW page counts, both preparation counts, setup+GC B/op/allocs/retained/peak and public ACK boundary. Keep all failed/noisy packets.
- [ ] #5095 unchanged five-pair numerical/noise/foreground/storage gates pass after integration, or the measured residual triggers another explicit architecture decision. This diagnostic/child alone cannot authorize a material foreground regression or parent completion.
- [ ] Refresh the owned-allocator sections of recoverable-root-set-maintenance-3681.md, concurrency-paradigms.md and verification.md with the private-builder freeze/rollback/lifetime contract. No on-disk format or public API change is selected.

## Decision boundary and alternatives

If ownership isolation consumes the projected savings, or the original whole-call/foreground gates remain unmet, retain the negative result and reassess before another mechanism. Separate repeated closure projection is a possible owner-local successor requiring exact captured-root/frontier/count proof; it is not permission to skip registration, invent an empty logical delta or cache physical authority. Compressed-prefix formats and generation fusion remain conditional separate designs.
